query: REPLACE INTO events OVERWRITE WHERE __time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND __time < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' SELECT TIME_FLOOR(__time, 'PT1H') AS __time, region, device, COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(amount) AS amount_sum, MAX(latency_ms) AS latency_max FROM TABLE(EXTERN('s3://prod-events/year=2024/', '{"type":"json"}', '[{"name":"__time","type":"long"},{"name":"region","type":"string"},{"name":"device","type":"string"},{"name":"amount","type":"double"},{"name":"latency_ms","type":"long"}]')) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 PARTITIONED BY HOUR CLUSTERED BY region, device
